title: ParameterIDs.h v1 inventory, APVTS layout with skews, bus layout (mono/stereo in -> stereo out), PluginProcessor spine with prepareToPlay allocation and PDC hooks
description:
Create ParameterIDs.h and the PluginProcessor spine. This task is the sole owner of PluginProcessor in phase A.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §§4.9, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11 (bus layout if present), 13
- /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredeq/Source/ParameterIDs.h
- /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredeq/Source/PluginProcessor.h and createParameterLayout / isBusesLayoutSupported patterns in PluginProcessor.cpp
- /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/aural-maximizer-pro/Source/PluginProcessor.cpp (NormalisableRange helpers, bus layout)
- CMakeLists.txt target name ShredWidth from a.1

Implement:
1. Source/ParameterIDs.h — namespace ShredWidth::ParameterIDs with schema/layout version constant (parameterLayoutVersion / schemaVersion = 1) and stable never-renumbered string IDs:
   - detuneAmount (0–25 cents, default 7)
   - delayL (1–50 ms, default 12.5)
   - delayR (1–50 ms, default 18.0)
   - monoXover (80–300 Hz, default 180)
   - width (0–200 %, default 100)
   - mix (0–100 % wet, default 40)
   - latencyMode choice {Studio, Live}, default Studio
   - outTrim (−12…+12 dB, default 0)
   - bypass bool default false
   - monoSource choice {Sum, Left}, default Sum (hidden; not for GUI in v1)
   detuneAmount is one control applied later as +amount L / −amount R — do not invent dual detune IDs.

2. Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp:
   - Class ShredWidthAudioProcessor : juce::AudioProcessor with APVTS member constructed from createParameterLayout().
   - createParameterLayout registers all ParameterIDs with correct types/ranges/defaults; monoXover uses NormalisableRange with log skew ≈ 0.35; AudioParameterChoice for latencyMode and monoSource; AudioParameterBool for bypass.
   - isBusesLayoutSupported: accept {mono in → stereo out} and {stereo in → stereo out}; reject all others (including mono→mono — dry Mix=0 passthrough for mono hosts is a future processBlock policy note, not a supported bus layout).
   - prepareToPlay: store sampleRate/maxBlock; pre-allocate worst-case Studio buffers owned by the processor spine (or clearly sized member buffers ready for later engine handoff): 2× pitch circular buffers length 2048+4 guard, 2× delay lines ceil(50ms * maxSampleRate)+guard, 1× dry-align delay 1024 samples (stereo channels as needed), meter FIFO ring capacity ≥ 4096 frames. No allocation paths intended for the audio thread beyond this prepare.
   - setLatencySamples to Studio nominal L/2 = 1024 by default; hook for Live (512/2 = 256) when latencyMode reads Live (may be a simple prepare/read of raw param for now).
   - processBlock stub: juce::ScopedNoDenormals at top; clear unused outputs; no DSP yet.
   - Standard JUCE boilerplate: releaseResources, createEditor forward decl, getName, programs, accept/produce MIDI false, getTailLengthSeconds 0, get/setStateInformation stubs that copy APVTS state as XML (a.3 will deepen StateManager integration — keep thin XML round-trip or delegate placeholders without requiring StateManager symbols if not yet present).
   - createPluginFilter factory returning new ShredWidthAudioProcessor().

Do not implement StateManager class, full editor UI, or DSP engine classes. Do not edit CMakeLists.txt (a.1 sole owner).
acceptance_criteria: Source/ParameterIDs.h exists with stable string IDs: detuneAmount, delayL, delayR, monoXover, width, mix, latencyMode, outTrim, bypass, monoSource
Source/PluginProcessor.cpp createParameterLayout registers all v1 parameters with spec ranges/defaults including monoXover log skew ~0.35
isBusesLayoutSupported accepts only mono→stereo and stereo→stereo
prepareToPlay allocates Studio worst-case pitch buffers (2048+4), delay lines for 50 ms at max SR, dry-align 1024, and meter FIFO without audio-thread reallocation design
setLatencySamples / getLatencySamples path reports Studio nominal 1024 by default
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: renumber or rename stable parameter string IDs
add dual independent L/R detune parameters
implement PitchShifter, DelayLineFrac, MonoSafetyCrossover, WidthProcessor, or ShredWidthEngine
accept mono→mono or multi-channel bus layouts beyond mono/stereo in → stereo out

allowed: NormalisableRange skew helper local to PluginProcessor.cpp
temporary buffer members on the processor until ShredWidthEngine exists
thin get/setStateInformation APVTS XML until StateManager wires in a.3
forbidden: change CMake formats or plugin codes
surface monoSource on a GUI in this task
